units.source_text: 要是一般棋赛，最后一分钟大竹七段大可下百手，勇猛逼近。

en.t: If this were an ordinary game, in the final minute Otake 7-dan could have played a hundred moves, pressing forward with fierce momentum.

units.source_text: 可这盘棋还有六七个小时，时间从容，一旦进入收官阶段，竞争的神经就像顺着急流而下，一泻千里。

en.t: But this game still had six or seven hours left, so there was plenty of time; once it entered the endgame, the nerves of competition would rush downstream like a swift current, pouring away in one unstoppable surge.

units.source_text: 好像自己在催促自己，往往不由得把手伸进棋盒里，又倏忽陷入沉思。

en.t: As if urging himself on, he would often unconsciously reach his hand into the go-stone bowl, then suddenly sink back into deep thought.

units.source_text: 连名人也一度抓起棋子，久久地犹豫不决。

en.t: Even the Master at one point picked up a stone and hesitated for a long time, unable to decide.
